rows.jyutping: ling6 A jan3 zoeng6 sam1 hak1
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something strongly affects someone, usually favourably.

example.english: This documentary really did impress me.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片真係令我印象深刻。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 jan3 zoeng6 sam1 hak1

rows.note: Choose this when impressing someone specifically means making them admire or respect you.

example.english: Starting your own company at such a young age really does impress me.
example.traditional: 你咁後生就自己開公司，真係令我佩服。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zi6 gei2 hoi1 gung1 si1 zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 pui3 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when someone impresses by performing exceptionally well, especially in a game or public performance.

example.english: They did impress everyone by performing excellently in the game.
example.traditional: 佢哋喺場波入面表現出色，贏晒全場掌聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hai2 coeng4 bo1 jap6 min6 biu2 jin6 ceot1 sik1 jeng4 saai3 cyun4 coeng4 zoeng2 sing1

rows.jyutping: lau4 dai1 sam1 hak1 jan3 zoeng6
rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on leaving a vivid or lasting impression in someone's mind.

example.english: The scenery from that trip did impress me deeply.
example.traditional: 嗰次旅行嘅景色喺我心入面留低深刻印象。
example.jyutping: go2 ci3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 ging2 sik1 hai2 ngo5 sam1 jap6 min6 lau4 dai1 sam1 hak1 jan3 zoeng6
